title: Spiral Muse
description: A surreal painting features a bald, pale female face with colorful eyes emerging from the top of a vibrant swirling vortex. Musical notes, colorful circles, and dripping paint flow along the spiral against a cosmic background of clouds and nebulae, with abstract colorful drips and waves at the bottom.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting of a bald ethereal female face with vibrant eyes emerging from a large swirling spiral vortex made of musical notes, colorful rings, and dripping paint. The background shows a cosmic nebula with purple, magenta, and golden clouds. Abstract colorful paint drips and wavy forms occupy the bottom of the composition in a painterly style with visible brushstrokes and splatters.
